instruction: I want to enable a global play/pause hotkey in VLC so I can control playback from any application. How do I configure a global keyboard shortcut for play/pause?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
